subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

James is just an old __eccentric.__
solution:
The correct answer is: **Cranky**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The word **"eccentric"** means unconventional or slightly strange in behavior or appearance. (विचित्र / अनोखा)

 
 
• **Example:** The artist was known for his eccentric style and unusual habits.
 
 
 
• **"Cranky"** means irritable or eccentric in a way that suggests odd behavior. (चिड़चिड़ा / विचित्र)
 
 
• **Example:** After a long day, he became cranky and refused to talk to anyone.
 
 
 
• Hence, "cranky" is the closest synonym to "eccentric" in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Cranky**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Ordinary** (साधारण): Something normal or usual without any special or distinctive features.

 
 
• **Example:** She led an ordinary life without any extraordinary events.
 
 
 
• **Follower** (अनुयायी): A person who supports or admires a particular leader or set of ideas.
 
 
• **Example:** He is a devoted follower of the new political movement.
 
 
 
• **Humble** (नम्र): Having or showing a modest or low estimate of one’s importance.
 
 
• **Example:** Despite his success, he remained humble and approachable.
